name: D8 raw-action temporal curve capacity audit
purpose: determine whether D7 failed because frozen D6 tokens discard fine action/contact information
scope: TRAIN-only same-example diagnostic; cannot authorize DEV, TEST, deployment, or visual transfer

data.selection: identical eight groups used by D6 staged and D7 audits

model.scene_encoder: shared MLP over normalized 61-dimensional current state
model.action_encoder: shared GRU over each endpoint's raw first eight control steps
model.pair_features: endpoint-symmetric mean, absolute difference, product, and shared scene embedding
model.level_context: two permutation-equivariant self-attention blocks without level positions
model.output: log1p early/full gaps plus 39-sample separation curve per level

optimization.batching: deterministic full batch of all eight groups and six levels

frozen_gates.decision: all conditions must pass at the fixed final checkpoint

interpretation.direct_passes: frozen D6 tokens are the immediate information bottleneck; redesign the deployable representation
interpretation.direct_fails: raw inputs do not rescue exact fit under matched training; curve parameterization or optimization remains limiting
